name: INTO Stirling: Scotland Education Centre
description: INTO Stirling offers a guaranteed route to a range of top universities in Scotland. We get to know students during their preparation program. Then, when it comes to choosing which degree to progress to, we offer students personalized progression support to help them find the right one – at the best university for them.Our International Foundation program is recognized by a variety of universities across Scotland – including those with QS 5-Stars Excellence and UK and global leaders in accounting, engineering and computing.Guaranteed offer letter for one or more degrees at Stirling or Strathclyde offered to students upon successful completion of preparation program.Personalized progression support including regular one-to-one sessions with Student Services, visits from our university partners and university masterclasses to support university applications.Located in the heart of Scotland on the University of Stirling campus. There are quick rail links to Glasgow and Edinburgh – two of the UK’s top three student cities (QS Best Student Cities 2023). Timestamps Updated
